ceo_directive: Distinguish NO_MOTIVATION_FOUND from MOTIVATION_SEARCH_INCOMPLETE. If search is incomplete, never infer absence of motivation.

FOUND.definition: Motivation evidence found in primary claims (exact passage retrieved)
FOUND.implication: 103 may be OBVIOUS — proceed to expectation/compatibility analysis
FOUND.action: Document the passage, assess expectation of success, check teaching away

NOT_FOUND_AFTER_COMPLETE_SEARCH.definition: Search was complete (all discovery sources exhausted) and no motivation passage found
NOT_FOUND_AFTER_COMPLETE_SEARCH.implication: 103 leans NON_OBVIOUS — but still requires patent counsel confirmation
NOT_FOUND_AFTER_COMPLETE_SEARCH.action: Document search completeness; recommend patent counsel opinion

SEARCH_INCOMPLETE.definition: Discovery did not cover all sources (PatSnap balance exhausted, EPO OPS/USPTO not configured)
SEARCH_INCOMPLETE.implication: CANNOT infer absence of motivation — 103 is UNCERTAIN
SEARCH_INCOMPLETE.action: Never say 'no motivation found' — say 'search incomplete, motivation state unknown'
SEARCH_INCOMPLETE.critical_rule: If search is incomplete, the system MUST NOT infer absence of motivation.

current_state_for_invention_1.rationale: PatSnap discovery endpoints BALANCE_EXHAUSTED; EPO OPS/USPTO/Lens not configured. 18-ref corpus is not a complete search.

ci_rule: If 103_evidence_state = SEARCH_INCOMPLETE, then 103_status MUST be UNCERTAIN. Never NON_OBVIOUS.
